== Description ==
Identified: [[Garrett Larson]] (navy Milwaukee Brewers cap, full beard, glasses, and a navy tee; same face as [[:File:Garrett Larson 2024 Retro Charity.jpg]]). Remaining faces unlabeled, including the player in a purple mask, the player in a light-blue hoodie, the player in a beige cap and a grey tank, and others around the brown- and orange-sleeved table.

Players drafting brown- and orange-sleeved cards at the [[2026 World Championship Cube Draft]], 23 October 2026.
